reason: The plugin is a utility for number text transformation: it converts numeric input into Chinese uppercase wording (for amount/bill contexts) and supports decimals and negative values, with no external network dependency indicated.

summaries.zh: 数字转大写插件可将阿拉伯数字转换为中文大写金额/票据表述，支持小数与负数输入。
summaries.en: This plugin converts Arabic numerals into Chinese uppercase wording for amount-style usage, with support for decimal and negative numbers.

capabilities: Converts Arabic numerals to Chinese uppercase words.
Supports decimal and negative number conversion.
Runs as an installed DSH plugin tool for user invocation.
Does not rely on external services per README description.
